commit_message: Add shared Graph and UI authoring services
pr_title: GameEngine: add Graph and UI authoring service foundation
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the ADR 0121 shared authoring-service foundation for generic semantic Graph documents and declarative UI documents.

- centralizes Read/Preview/ProjectDataWrite permission enforcement
- adds revision + generation stale-base protection without changing persisted Graph/UI formats
- makes Graph preview/apply domain-aware while preserving the separate GraphView presentation boundary
- adds UI preview/apply over UiDocumentTransaction with atomic rejection on invalid commands or final validation
- makes UiDocumentCommand and UiDocumentChange structured serde payloads for later CLI/MCP adapters

This PR intentionally establishes the shared service boundary first. Editor/CLI/MCP adapter routing and generic layout exposure follow in the next ADR 0121 PR.
